Application Data.NAME: Heritage Antiques & Collectibles
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Heritage Antiques & Collectibles specializes in the sale of vintage items, antiques, and collectibles, including furniture, jewelry, artwork, and memorabilia. We curate a diverse selection of high-quality pieces that are sourced from reputable dealers and estate sales. Our goal is to provide customers with unique finds that reflect the history and craftsmanship of bygone eras, while offering personalized service and expert advice on maintaining and valuing their collectibles.
